answer.explanation: From 00:27:02 onward the ThumbnailerFunction logged 503 NoSuchBucket errors on s3:PutObject (line 43 of handler.py, Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET), with none in the other three functions. A NoSuchBucket response means the target bucket does not exist, not that access was denied, so this is not an IAM issue. The invocations themselves otherwise look normal (about 90-180 ms, 105 MB of 1024 MB used), so the function is pointing at a bucket name that does not exist. The same NoSuchBucket failure burst also occurred 2026-10-22 21:12-21:27, which suggests recurring misconfiguration. Limitation: I could not read the live function configuration or the IaC template with the tools available, so the exact bad value and whether it was set live or in IaC are unconfirmed. The logs do not show the bucket name.
